deficits.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked
deficits.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk at least 1m wide along the left side of the road.
Remove obstructions from the footway to ensure it is fully usable.
Repair and level the footway to eliminate trip hazards.

deficits.evidence: marked crossing without refuge on wide road
deficits.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: crossing is hard to see and obstructed
deficits.suggestion: Improve visibility of the crossing with better markings and signage, and ensure it is not obstructed by vehicles or other objects.
Install kerb ramps at the crossing to facilitate safe pedestrian access.

ratings.reason: A wide, paved footway is clearly visible on the left side in all frames.
There are utility poles and signage on the footway that could be considered obstructions.
The image resolution is insufficient to identify specific uneven sections or trip hazards.
The crossing is wide and lacks a central refuge island.
The crossing markings are clearly visible and not obstructed in the frames.
The angle of the frames does not clearly show the kerb interface at the crossing.
